title: Prioritized hotpath sampler and annotated log-joiner for tail-latency investigations
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: debugging the fat-tail of token-latency has been time-consuming because sampled traces miss the small subset of invocations that exercise rarely-hit kernel paths (prefetch contention, KV cache cold misses, and model quantization fallbacks). This PR introduces a prioritized "hotpath" sampler that boosts sampling probability for invocations that exhibit early indicators of tail behavior and an annotated log-joiner that attaches compact enrichment metadata to traces for faster root-cause grouping. Design summary: (1) Hotpath sampler lives in telemetry/samplers and runs a lightweight rule engine over request metadata and early model-stage signals (kernel-time-estimates, kv_cache_miss_hint, prefix-shape). Sampling is priority-weighted by a configurable score; weights resolve deterministically to keep sampling stable across retries. (2) Annotated log-joiner is a small service/agent that performs signal extraction from structured logs and attaches 128-bit stable anchors to traces (implemented as polyglot library with Go+Python bindings). Anchors allow compact joins in the observability backend without shipping full logs. (3) Rollout plan: feature flag gate feature.hotpath_sampler, canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with dashboard and alert quieting during ramp. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for score heuristics - [x] integration tests with trace backend - [x] dashboard & alerts - [x] e2e throughput bench in perf-lab - [x] docs and config example Files changed: telemetry/samplers/hotpath_sampler.go, pkg/logjoiner/annotated_joiner.py, observability/dashboards/hotpath-sampler-dashboard.json, console/alerts/hotpath-tail-slo.yaml, telemetry/README.md, test/integration/hotpath_sampler_test.go, scripts/ramp_hotpath_flag.sh, deploy/featureflags/hotpath.yaml. Impact and safety: scoring is conservative by default (base-sample-rate left unchanged) and only increases sampling probability for invocations with score > 0.4; the service is rate-limited and uses reservoir caps to ensure observability ingestion cost stays bounded. Migration notes: ops can opt to emit anchors as trace attributes or as log metadata; we added a toggle in telemetry/README.md. Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes; the annotated joiner provides a compatibility shim for backends that don't consume anchors. Monitoring: added a hotpath-sampler dashboard (per-model share, score distribution, sampled vs unsampled ratio), a compact anchor-sparsity panel, and an alert hotpath-tail-slo which is cohort-aware and will auto-suppress for low-volume tenants. Ops runbook included in telemetry/README.md. CI: flaky integration test flaked once and was re-run in CI; final status PASS. Merge: squash-merged after approvals and CI green.

Priya Desai (request changes): need a cap on daily sampling cost per-tenant. Author: added reservoir cap and a config knob per tenant in deploy/featureflags/hotpath.yaml.
Liam O'Connor (approval): code/lgtm, dashboard panels are helpful; recommend we add a collapsed timeline view for anchor joins in a follow-up.
CI Bot: integration test suite flaky: TestHotpathSamplerScore; rerun resolved the transient GPU kernel timing dependency.
release_notes: Introduces a prioritized hotpath sampler to increase trace coverage of tail invocations and an annotated log-joiner to attach compact anchors for fast trace-log joins. Includes dashboards and cohort-aware alert tuning. Feature gated and opt-in by default.
risk: medium - bounded by reservoir caps and feature-flagged
rollout: feature.hotpath_sampler canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%; ops script scripts/ramp_hotpath_flag.sh and runbook in docs/ops/hotpath_runbook.md
notes: This PR complements existing tail-sampling work but targets early indicators and introduces compact anchors to reduce storage and join cost; follow-up PR will add a small UI in Console to inspect anchor joins.
